body_markdown:
Italian news channel Sky TG24 featured Sòphia High Tech in a recent report: journalist Gaia Bozza interviewed Antonio Caraviello and Domenico Borrelli about the company’s work.


Based in Somma Vesuviana, near Naples, Sòphia High Tech manufactures ultra-high-precision components for the aerospace industry, combining traditional machining with advanced manufacturing technologies.


Sòphia High Tech is part of Genenta Science (Nasdaq: GNTA), as Pierluigi Paracchi explains in the segment.
